prompt:
Use only the supplied current.db and README. All windows below are UTC and half-open, selected by logical-operation open time. A terminal-failure percentage has logical operations as its denominator; attempt-failure percentage has attempts as its denominator. Return only JSON matching the provided schema. Percentages use 0–100, differences use percentage points. evidence_sql must contain executable read-only SQLite queries with literal bounds, not pseudocode. Arrays may be in any order; include every requested group. A zero numerator is not missing data. No web or network access is needed.

Report ledger-sync reliability for 2026-05-09: reference 10:00–11:00 versus incident 11:00–12:00. Report the authoritative event source for these windows (registry version, event table, event grain and effective start). For each period and actual serving PHYSICAL pool, report logical operations, terminal failures, terminal-failure percentage, retried operations, retry percentage and mean end-to-end latency_ms. Do not treat routing intent or an individual execution identity as a physical pool. Also give all-pool operations, terminal failures and terminal-failure percentage per period; identify the physical pool with the largest increase and report that increase in pp. In assessment state what the report establishes and the important attribution/counting limitations.

arguments.command:
cd /data; sqlite3 -header current.db "select * from feed_registry; select strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M',1778284800000/1000,'unixepoch');"; cat > /work/ls9.sql <<'EOF'
with ops as (select o.operation_id, o.route_id, o.opened_at_ms, case when o.opened_at_ms>=1778320800000 and o.opened_at_ms<1778324400000 then 'reference_10_11' when o.opened_at_ms>=1778324400000 and o.opened_at_ms<1778328000000 then 'incident_11_12' end period
 from logical_operations o join service_routes r using(route_id) join services s on s.service_id=r.service_id where s.service_code='ledger-sync' and o.opened_at_ms>=1778320800000 and o.opened_at_ms<1778328000000),
asg as (select ops.*, ra.pool_id from ops join route_assignments ra on ra.route_id=ops.route_id and ops.opened_at_ms>=ra.effective_from_ms and ops.opened_at_ms<ra.effective_to_ms),
att as (select a.operation_id, count(*) n from attempt_events a group by a.operation_id),
lst as (select a.operation_id, f.is_success last_ok, a.completed_at_ms from attempt_events a join failure_codes f using(code_id) where a.attempt_no=(select max(b.attempt_no) from attempt_events b where b.operation_id=a.operation_id))
select asg.period, p.pool_code, count(*) operations, sum(lst.last_ok=0) terminal_failures, round(100.0*sum(lst.last_ok=0)/count(*),4) terminal_failure_pct,
 sum(att.n>1) retried_operations, round(100.0*sum(att.n>1)/count(*),4) retry_pct, round(avg(lst.completed_at_ms-asg.opened_at_ms),4) mean_latency_ms
from asg join worker_pools p using(pool_id) join att using(operation_id) join lst using(operation_id) where asg.period is not null group by asg.period, p.pool_code order by 1,2;
EOF
sqlite3 -header current.db < /work/ls9.sql
sqlite3 -header current.db "select asg_period, count(*) from (select case when o.opened_at_ms<1778324400000 then 'ref' else 'inc' end asg_period from logical_operations o join service_routes r using(route_id) join services s on s.service_id=r.service_id where s.service_code='ledger-sync' and o.opened_at_ms>=1778320800000 and o.opened_at_ms<1778328000000) group by 1;
select r.route_key, ra.pool_id, ra.effective_from_ms, ra.effective_to_ms, count(*) from logical_operations o join service_routes r using(route_id) join route_assignments ra on ra.route_id=o.route_id and o.opened_at_ms>=ra.effective_from_ms and o.opened_at_ms<ra.effective_to_ms where r.service_id=2 and o.opened_at_ms>=1778320800000 and o.opened_at_ms<1778328000000 group by 1,2,3,4;
select count(*) from logical_operations o where o.route_id in (select route_id from service_routes where service_id=2) and o.opened_at_ms>=1778320800000 and o.opened_at_ms<1778328000000 and not exists (select 1 from attempt_events a where a.operation_id=o.operation_id);"
